# Environment Switches

<!-- Generated by `flint env --book`; edit crates/flint-core/src/env.rs, not this page.
     CI's headless job runs `flint env --check-book`. -->

Flint reads a few `FLINT_*` environment variables, for what a flag can't reach easily (a perf A/B, a test harness, a device profile). Each is listed here from the one table the engine reads them through (`flint_core::env`). `flint env` prints the same list with each switch's value in this shell, and `flint env --json` as data.

A value a switch doesn't accept is said once, as a warning naming the forms it takes, and the default is used: `FLINT_VSYNC=fasle` warns rather than measuring with vsync on. An empty value is the same as unset.

A switch that is the alias of a flag or a quality key (`FLINT_VSYNC` of `--vsync`, `FLINT_LOD_SCALE` of `--quality lod_scale=`) says so: the flag or key wins when given, and the variable is read only when it isn't.

## Window

| Variable | Accepts | Unset | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FLINT_VSYNC` | 1\|on\|fifo\|0\|off\|immediate\|mailbox | vsync (fifo) | How frames are presented: 1\|on\|fifo waits for vsync, 0\|off\|immediate is unlocked (real frame times for perf runs), mailbox renders uncapped and shows the newest frame each refresh. Alias of `--vsync`, which wins when given |
| `FLINT_FRAME_LATENCY` | a whole number from 1 to 3 | 2 | Frames the CPU may queue ahead of the display. Alias of `--frame-latency`, which wins when given |
| `FLINT_PACING` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | on | Pace the game clock to the monitor's refresh when frames wait for vsync; 0 turns it off. Alias of `--no-pacing`, which wins when given |

## Renderer

| Variable | Accepts | Unset | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FLINT_LOD_SCALE` | a number of at least 0.05 | 1 | Multiplies every LOD switch distance (under 1 drops to coarser levels sooner). Alias of `--quality lod_scale=`, which wins when given |
| `FLINT_DRAW_DISTANCE_SCALE` | a number of at least 0.05 | 1 | Multiplies every entity's draw distance. Alias of `--quality draw_distance_scale=`, which wins when given |
| `FLINT_STYLE_SCISSOR` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | on | Per-entity styles scissor their passes to their entities; 0 draws them full-frame, to check the two match byte for byte |
| `FLINT_STYLE_SHADER_DIR` | a path | the built-in shaders | Read the style shaders from this folder (crates/flint-render/src/stylize) and rebuild on save, without a rebuild of the engine |
| `FLINT_SHADER_CHECKS` | all\|default | every check but loop bounding | all also keeps loop bounding in the engine's own shaders (it costs ASCII's pass 2.6x GPU) |
| `FLINT_GPU_LABELS` | 0\|off\|groups\|1\|on\|draws | draws under a capture tool, else groups | How much of a frame is named for GPU debuggers (RenderDoc, PIX): off, groups (each part of the frame) or draws (a marker per draw too) |
| `FLINT_GPU_WAIT_TIMEOUT` | a number of at least 0 | no limit | Seconds any wait for the GPU may take before the process panics naming a hung device; 0 is no limit |

## Player

| Variable | Accepts | Unset | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FLINT_FRAME_HISTORY` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | the build's frame-history feature (on) | Record every frame for the F2 frame history |
| `FLINT_HITCH_FACTOR` | a number of at least 1 | 2 | A frame is a hitch over this many times the rolling median frame time |
| `FLINT_HITCH_FLOOR_MS` | a number of at least 0 | 24 | ...and at least this many milliseconds over it, at any refresh rate |
| `FLINT_PERF_LOG` | a path | stderr only | Also append each perf summary line to this file (Android sets it beside a perf profile) |
| `FLINT_SHADOWS` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | on | 0 starts with the shadow pass off. Alias of `--quality shadows=`, which wins when given |
| `FLINT_SHADOW_RES` | a whole number from 256 to 4096 | 2048 | Each shadow cascade's map, texels on a side. Alias of `--quality shadow_resolution=`, which wins when given |
| `FLINT_PROCGEN_CACHE` | a folder, or 0\|off\|false for none | .flint/procgen-cache/ at the project root | Where procedural generation caches what it built on disk; 0 keeps no disk cache |

## Asset generation

| Variable | Accepts | Unset | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FLINT_FLUX_API_KEY` | a key | the key in flint.toml's [providers.flux] | The Flux provider's API key, over the config file's |
| `FLINT_MESHY_API_KEY` | a key | the key in flint.toml's [providers.meshy] | The Meshy provider's API key, over the config file's |
| `FLINT_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` | a key | the key in flint.toml's [providers.elevenlabs] | The ElevenLabs provider's API key, over the config file's |

## Test harnesses

| Variable | Accepts | Unset | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FLINT_REQUIRE_GPU` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | off | A GPU test that finds no adapter fails instead of passing as skipped (CI's GPU job sets it) |
| `FLINT_BLESS` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | off | Golden tests rewrite their goldens instead of comparing against them |
| `FLINT_GOLDENS_OUT` | a path | a temporary folder, removed on a pass | Where render_goldens writes its renders and diffs, kept |
| `FLINT_GPU_TEST_PARALLEL` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | on | GPU tests share the device alongside each other; 0 lends it one test at a time |
| `FLINT_GPU_TEST_PIPELINE_CACHE` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | on | GPU tests share built pipelines; 0 builds each test's own (an A/B of build cost) |
| `FLINT_GPU_TEST_TIMES` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | off | Print a line per GPU test: how long it held the device and built pipelines |
| `FLINT_GPU_TEST_TIMEOUT` | a whole number of at least 1 | the harness's DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S | Seconds a GPU test may hold the device before the binary is called hung and aborted |
| `FLINT_QUALITY_PNG` | a path | none | flint-render's quality test writes its frames to this folder |
| `FLINT_PANELS_DUMP` | a path | none | flint-render's panels test writes a frame to this folder |
| `FLINT_CUBIC_MODEL` | a path | skipped | A glTF with CUBICSPLINE animation for flint-animation's opt-in cubicspline_model test |
| `FLINT_194_SAVE_DIR` | a path | none | gen_preview's spec-save test writes the old and new saves to this folder (#194) |
| `FLINT_LIVING_PRINT_DIGEST` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | off | Set by Living Props' determinism test for the copy of itself it runs |
| `FLINT_FORM_PRINT_DIGEST` | 1\|on\|true\|yes or 0\|off\|false\|no | off | Set by the form generator's determinism test for the copy of itself it runs |
